core: Growth hormone axis and body growth regulation
qualifier: with somatostatin and glucagon-family GPCR signaling
name: Growth hormone axis and body growth, with somatostatin/glucagon GPCRs
rationale: Members center on growth hormone receptor/JAK-STAT signaling, GH secretion, IGF and leptin input and control of organismal growth rate; unlike the prolactin/cytokine, IGF-response and thyroid confusables it adds somatostatin, glucagon-type receptor and adenylate cyclase GPCR signaling.

qualifier: Nodal-regulated left-right asymmetry and planar cell polarity
name: Left-right asymmetry and planar polarity in embryonic axis morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover left-right axis specification (Nodal regulation, nodal cilia, organ laterality) together with planar cell polarity and convergent extension; this left-right/Nodal component separates it from the neural plate/axial mesoderm, Wnt-calcium and Hedgehog/GLI confusables.

qualifier: via control of transcription factor DNA binding
name: Transcriptional repression via control of transcription factor DNA binding
rationale: Members describe generic negative regulation of Pol II transcription and initiation through modulating regulatory-region DNA binding (with TGFBR3 expression as an example target), whereas confusables are gene-specific programs (CDH1/CDH11, RUNX3, FOXO, TGF-beta/BMP).

qualifier: phospholipid remodeling and triglyceride lipid droplet turnover
name: Glycerophospholipid and triglyceride metabolism with lipid droplet turnover
rationale: Members span synthesis and acyl-chain remodeling of PC/PE/PS/PG/PI/CL, DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis and lipolysis, lipid droplets and adipocyte biology; the glycerophospholipid side separates it from fatty acid/TAG-only confusables, and the TAG/droplet side from the sphingolipid/membrane lipid confusable.

core: Nucleotide excision repair of UV damage
qualifier: global genome recognition and incision steps
name: Global genome excision repair of UV pyrimidine dimers
rationale: All members concern UV photolesion handling via global genome NER damage recognition, incision complex and dual incision; this excludes transcription-coupled NER and the gap-filling and translesion synthesis steps in the confusables.

qualifier: via endocardial cushion epithelial-mesenchymal transition
name: Atrioventricular valve formation via endocardial cushion EMT
rationale: Members describe endocardial cushion EMT and fusion forming the mitral and tricuspid valves, unlike confusables covering outflow tract/semilunar valves, septation, trabeculation and myocardium.

qualifier: by TLR2/TLR4 with CD14
name: TLR2/TLR4 sensing of bacterial lipopolysaccharide and lipopeptides
rationale: Members cover detection of LPS (LBP-CD14 transfer), lipoteichoic acid and diacyl lipopeptides through TLR4 and TLR2 signaling, distinguishing it from NOD/peptidoglycan sensing and generic myeloid inflammatory modules.

qualifier: Aurora A and PLK1 regulation
name: Aurora A and PLK1 control of mitotic centrosome maturation
rationale: Members describe recruitment of centrosome proteins (NuMA, Nlp loss), spindle assembly and AURKA/PLK1 activation and turnover at mitotic entry; the Aurora A/PLK1 kinase regulation distinguishes it from centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation and NEK-kinase confusables.

qualifier: cerebral cortex layering, regionalization and commissures
name: Neuronal migration and cerebral cortex layering, regionalization and commissures
rationale: Members cover radial and tangential neuronal migration, cortical layering and regionalization, forebrain neuron specification and commissural/corticospinal tract formation; this separates it from reelin/dendrite, neuroblast division, spinal cord patterning and cerebellar confusables.

qualifier: phosphatase dephosphorylation of ERK, JNK and p38
name: Phosphatase-mediated negative feedback on ERK, JNK and p38 MAPKs
rationale: Members describe MAPK inactivation by threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation, negative regulation of JNK and p38 and feedback on AP-1 activation, unlike confusables about TAK1-driven activation, ERK-only/serine phosphorylation control or IL-6 signaling.

qualifier: endoderm specification and primitive gut morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation, endoderm specification and primitive gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members span primitive streak, gastrulation EMT and mesoderm migration, pluripotency factor control, definitive endoderm specification and fore/hindgut morphogenesis; the endoderm/gut component separates it from cardiac mesoderm and pancreatic lineage confusables.

qualifier: sodium-phosphate cotransporters and FGF23-Klotho signaling
name: Phosphate homeostasis via sodium-phosphate cotransporters and FGF23-Klotho signaling
rationale: Members cover type II Na+/Pi (SLC34) transport and its disorders, FGFR1c-Klotho signaling, PTH response and bone mineralization; this phosphate-transport focus separates it from tooth/ectopic mineralization and vitamin D metabolism confusables.

qualifier: assembly and maintenance in epithelial cell-cell adhesion
name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly and maintenance in epithelial adhesion
rationale: Members describe calcium-dependent cadherin (CDH1, CDH11) adhesion, adherens junction assembly/maintenance and E-cadherin trafficking and degradation; this separates it from desmosome/hemidesmosome, apical-basal polarity and EMT-regulation confusables.

qualifier: reuptake and astrocytic glutamate-glutamine handling
name: Glutamate transporters, reuptake and astrocytic glutamate-glutamine cycling
rationale: All members concern glutamate transporters (EAAT1/SLC1A3, VGLUT3/SLC17A8), glutamate reuptake and intracellular glutamate homeostasis, distinguishing it from aspartate transport and GABA/glycine neurotransmitter confusables.

qualifier: BRCA1-BARD1 and BRCA2 defects
name: Double-strand break response and its BRCA1-BARD1/BRCA2 defects
rationale: Members are negative regulation of the DSB response and its impairment by BRCA1/BARD1 loss and BRCA2 DSS1-binding/nuclear translocation defects, unlike confusables about DSB sensing, NHEJ, resection and PALB2/RAD51 homologous recombination defects.

qualifier: downstream of insulin-like growth factor
name: IGF-AKT control of FOXO localization and transcription
rationale: Members describe AKT phosphorylation and nuclear exclusion of FOXO, FOXO acetylation and FOXO target transcription, with IGF/peptide response and hormone-mediated apoptosis; the IGF input distinguishes it from NFE2L2, TP53 metabolic, mTORC1 and glycolysis confusables.

qualifier: through TRK receptors and p75NTR
name: Neurotrophin signaling through TRK receptors and p75NTR
rationale: Members are NGF/BDNF/NT3/NT4 signaling via TRKA/B/C downstream cascades (RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, ERK5) and p75NTR death/survival signaling, distinct from the semaphorin, ephrin and netrin axon guidance and regeneration confusables.

qualifier: E2F-driven transitions, checkpoints and replication licensing
name: Cell cycle transitions, checkpoints and E2F-driven replication licensing
rationale: Members cover E2F/RB G1/S transcription, origin licensing and replication initiation, CDK and APC/C-controlled phase transitions and DNA damage checkpoints, plus proliferation modules; they lack the chromosome segregation, spindle, cytokinesis and meiosis content of the largest confusable.

core: Amino acid and oligopeptide transmembrane transport
qualifier: including cationic amino acids and ornithine
name: Cationic and neutral amino acid and oligopeptide transmembrane transport
rationale: Members describe transport of neutral and aromatic amino acids, peptides and the cationic amino acids lysine, arginine and ornithine (SLC7A7, SLC25A15 disorders); the cationic/ornithine and peptide transport separates it from neutral/imino acid, polyamine and renal solute confusables.

qualifier: inherited urea cycle enzyme deficiencies
name: Urea cycle and inherited urea cycle enzyme deficiencies
rationale: Members are urea cycle reactions (citrulline, arginine, ornithine, aspartate metabolism) and deficiencies of NAGS, CPS1, OTC, ASS1, ASL and ARG1, distinct from confusables on arginine catabolism, glutamate/proline metabolism and ornithine/cationic transport.

qualifier: with vasoactive peptide processing
name: Renin-angiotensin blood pressure control and vasoactive peptide processing
rationale: Members describe angiotensin generation and signaling regulating blood pressure, blood volume and renal sodium excretion, plus bradykinin and neuropeptide catabolism; the angiotensin/peptide processing distinguishes it from vasopressin water handling, natriuretic cGMP and aldosterone confusables.

qualifier: with actin-nucleating effectors
name: Rho-family GTPase cycles and their actin-nucleating effectors
rationale: Members are the RHO/RAC/CDC42/RND GTPase cycles and their effectors (formins, WASP/WAVE, IQGAPs) driving Arp2/3 nucleation and lamellipodia, distinguishing it from actin filament processes without GTPases and from narrower GTPase subsets.

core: Nuclear RNA surveillance and exosome decay
qualifier: with tRNA and small RNA processing
name: Nuclear RNA surveillance, exosome decay and tRNA/small RNA processing
rationale: Members cover 3'-5' exosome-mediated decay and trimming of mRNA, CUTs, rRNA, snRNA and snoRNA plus tRNA end processing, splicing and tRF/siRNA biogenesis; the tRNA/small RNA processing separates it from RNA modification, rRNA processing and mRNA splicing/export confusables.

qualifier: intraflagellar transport and membrane cargo targeting
name: Intraflagellar transport and ciliary membrane cargo targeting
rationale: Members describe anterograde/retrograde IFT, basal body anchoring, transition zone and BBSome, VxPx, ARL13B and myristoyl cargo routing into cilia, unlike confusables on cilium assembly control, motile axonemes and photoreceptor outer segments.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor-driven recruitment, respiratory burst and degranulation
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment, respiratory burst and degranulation
rationale: Members cover formyl peptide receptor and complement signaling, granulocyte chemotaxis control, respiratory burst, degranulation and myeloid inflammatory modules; the FPR-mediated recruitment plus oxidative burst combination separates it from extravasation, microbial killing, chemokine production and Fc receptor confusables.
